title: The Amorfino
description: A love or challenge song that reflects the wit of the montuvio people.

title: The Guagua Auca
description: The spirit of an unbaptized child who cries on the roads to lure travelers and make them lose their way.

title: The Animero
description: A real character from towns like Penipe who, during November, goes out to ask for prayers for the souls in purgatory with a bell.

title: The Tapada Lady
description: An elegant woman who appears in Guayaquil, attracts men with her perfume and then shows a skull face.

title: The Umiña Goddess
description: The origin of the sacred emerald in Manta.
